## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the user-visible problem and what changes. Link the relevant issue.
For a generator fix, include a minimal input and the expected generated output.

## Validation

- [ ] Added regression coverage for behavior changes.
- [ ] Ran `bash scripts/check.sh` and `go test -count=1 -timeout=5m ./...`.
- [ ] Inspected golden/fixture changes, if any.
- [ ] Noted compatibility changes, including minimum Go version or CLI behavior.

Use a conventional title (`fix:`, `feat:`, `ci:`, etc.) for release automation.
